headline: v3: 0 blocker / 0 major / 3 new minor; O2.1-O2.4 resolved. Every panel, tertile and outcome number reproduces, and a leave-one-out check gives no false 'shown' on any of the 9 panel runs. The pywebrtc NoiseSuppressor has no HPF at source level. Verdict: agree.

objections.claim: 'Shown' is not conditioned on run health, and a failed run passes it. (a)-(d) compare DiDs only, and placebo (e) cannot catch a single broken arm. Evaluated leave-one-out against the 9-run panel, the failed B2a has NS DiD -1.42 (z -6.38) and passes (a), (c) and (d), while its half-B WF1 is 85.18. It is also far off on the non-target VAD contrast (z +5.11). apm_ns falsifier (2) grants a lower-p retry exactly when WF1 drops and NS is 'shown', and the section 4 combined-run recommendation keys on 'shown'.
evidence: computed /tmp/b4crit3/panel3.py (LOO): B2a NS z -6.38, a=c=d=True; VAD z +5.11
rdloop/B4/debate/proposal_v3.md:350-351 (retry only if shown), :609-615 (section 4 keys on shown), :118-121 (placebo rule)
objections.required_change: In b4_dsp_slices.py, print the arm's z on every contrast. Flag the run 'anomalous' if |z| > 3 on a non-target primary contrast, or if the shared under-fit falsifier or the clean-F1 guard fires. While flagged, report the lever verdict as 'confounded (run anomaly)' instead of 'shown'. The apm_ns lower-p retry then requires 'shown' without the flag.

objections.claim: The outcome thresholds that let an arm escape falsifier (1) are inside cross-run noise. The heldout-F1 thresholds +0.5 / +0.8 are B2f-referenced, with z about 0.4 / 0.6 on the panel SD of 1.35 that v3 itself states. Against B2f, 5/9 panel runs reach +0.5 on final, 6/9 on merge, 6/9 on at least one readout, and 4/9 reach +0.8 on final. Even the one-flag B2e reads +0.12 / +0.58. So falsifier (1) of apm_ns and opus_plc fires for a null arm only about 1 time in 6, and the section 4 'opus_plc directional with positive outcome' path is weak evidence. The panel mixes config effects with noise, so it bounds the null rather than measuring it.
evidence: computed from the 9 runs' local_eval/{epoch_8|epoch_10,merge_top5}/metrics.json half_B.sets.sim_heldout_v1.f1: final delta vs 88.27 = -2.14,+1.19,-0.07,+0.12,+2.05,+0.89,+0.59,-1.59,+1.07; merge delta vs 87.92 = -2.11,+1.06,-0.01,+0.58,+2.28,+1.48,+0.63,-1.56,+0.60
objections.required_change: Print the panel SD and the count of panel runs clearing each heldout-F1 threshold. In falsifier (1), an arm escapes on outcome only with heldout F1 delta >= +0.5 on both readouts (opus_plc: name the readouts). For the section 4 recommendation, define 'positive outcome' as the wave's WF1 CI rule, not heldout F1 alone.

objections.claim: Placebo rule (e) has no rule for a missing arm. Verdicts stay provisional until all B4 arms are read, but two arms depend on owner-installed packages, and apm_ns has a 1.15 timing stop rule. An arm that never runs leaves (e) undefined.
evidence: rdloop/B4/debate/proposal_v3.md:125-126 (provisional until all arms read), :200-201 (apm stop rule)
objections.required_change: At SUMMARY, evaluate (e) on the arms that exist, plus the opus_plc zero-loss control if it ran. With no placebo arm, cap the verdict at 'directional'. Print the placebo count next to each verdict.

per_lever.note: The NS-only backend is confirmed at source level: webrtc::NoiseSuppressor + AudioBuffer, with no HPF. It has the best-powered contrast (bar -0.22, 46 % of the typical gap). The selftest is robust, and its no-HPF band is correctly chosen (an 80 Hz HPF reads 5.00 dB there). Add the run-anomaly flag (O3.1), because its lower-p retry keys on 'shown'.

Criterion (ii) is the best-calibrated test in the plan: no null run passes it, and it is reproduced with the pinned cuts (panel mu -10.2 / max 0). The VAD contrast is honestly demoted to 'directional', with the fill split pre-registered. (ii) needs about a 15-clip differential shift (z +2.6 from the panel mean), so a modest real effect may read 'inconclusive'.

The weak local premise is stated honestly, and the mechanism is capped at 'directional'. The arm is an outcome test of ADD-C with a zero-loss attribution control. Its outcome escape from falsifier (1) is noisy (O3.2). The cost reduction (0.85 projected) and the codec_draw_order / fallback bit-identity tests are good.

alternatives.idea: Owner-optional fourth arm: a B2f replicate (b4wave entry, all B4 flags off, same argv, about 4.4 h). It is the only same-config null for the three contrasts and for heldout F1 / WF1, the strongest placebo for (e), and a full-scale end-to-end check of the default-off path. The parent augmenter RNG is pid-seeded, so it is a genuine retrain, not a bit-replay.
alternatives.why: Addresses O3.2 at the root: the 9-run panel mixes config effects with noise, and no same-config replicate of B2f exists. Not required; the cost is one extra arm.

citation_checks.note: NoiseSuppressor wraps std::unique_ptr<webrtc::NoiseSuppressor> + AudioBuffer, with config.target_level = static_cast<NsConfig::SuppressionLevel>(level) and the error text 'level must be 0-3 (6/12/18/21 dB)'. HighPassFilter is created only in AudioProcessor (if hp_enabled_ || aec_enabled_) and EchoCanceller, so the NS-only path has no HPF.
process() takes audio 'of any length' and 'Internally splits into 10ms frames'. HPF appears only as an AudioProcessor option ('also enabled automatically with AEC').
'A frame must be either 10, 20, or 30 ms in duration' and '3 is the most aggressive' match. Sample rates are 8/16/32/48 kHz.

Section 4.4: 'The Mix strategy partially alleviates the degradation, yet still suffers noticeable performance drops under more severe distortions (e.g., AGC and VAD)'. Order AEC -> NS -> AGC -> VAD. Table 2 XLSR-AASIST clean-only 0.23/22.20, Mix 0.52/17.39. v3's 'last front-end stage' wording is accurate.

UR21 channel-robust ASVspoof 2021 system: codec / transmission and IR augmentation. The abstract does not mention packet loss. v3 cites it without a specific claim, so it is acceptable as background only.
